chapter: Films, Las Vegas and the union
title: Playing background music for the film Gypsy
summary: He recalls Rosalind Russell's 46 takes and playing with Shelly Manne.

story.theme_name: Jazz musicians in the movies and film scoring
story.community_name: Jazz musicians on film and studio scoring

blocks.x: You were mentioning also another film that you were in that's not listed in the book, and that's Gypsy. Isn't that right?

Oh, I played in the background music in that picture, with Rosalind Russell. The thing that stands out in my mind about that is that Rosalind Russell actually sang some of the songs. You know, she wasn't really a singer, and so we probably did about 46 takes on one thing that she did, and they pieced it together, and you know, they do marvelous...they do magic with the scissors out in the studios -- so she came over just great. I saw it... The picture was on the other night, in the Natalie Wood series that was going on. Natalie was actually Gypsy, and Rosalind Russell was her mother, who was a typical stage mother -- at least that was the role she played.
Were there other Jazz musicians on that film?
Let's see. I think it was Shelly Manne and I, and I can't remember who else was on it. I remember
Shelley because... Well, everybody remembers Shelly that works with him.
